"""design_D568 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특징 테이블과 학습/평가 분할 생성 (학습·성능 계산 없음).

설계서와 다른 처리(보고서의 findings 참조, 확인 전 잠정):
  - cr_last: collect_time 대신 report_time <= 퇴원 기준 (퇴원 시점에 보이지 않는 결과 제외)
  - dx_*, n_dx: 인덱스 입원의 진단만 사용 (미래 입원의 진단 혼입 방지), ICD는 접두 일치
  - 분할 키: family_id (없으면 patient_id로 대체) — split_unit/cv_key와 일치
"""
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupShuffleSplit

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA, OUT = WS / "data", Path(__file__).resolve().parent
design = json.loads((WS / "design_D568.json").read_text())

pat = pd.read_csv(DATA / "patients.csv.gz")
adm = pd.read_csv(DATA / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
labs = pd.read_csv(DATA / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
orders = pd.read_csv(DATA / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(DATA / "diagnoses.csv.gz")

# 결과: 퇴원(tp) 후 30일 안에 다음 입원 시작
adm = adm.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
adm["tp"] = adm["discharge_time"]
adm["next_admit"] = adm.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
gap = adm["next_admit"] - adm["tp"]
adm["readmit_30d"] = (gap >= pd.Timedelta(0)) & (gap <= pd.Timedelta(days=30))
data_end = adm["admit_time"].max()
adm["followup_complete"] = adm["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30) <= data_end
adm["n_prior_adm"] = adm.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()
adm["los_h"] = (adm["discharge_time"] - adm["admit_time"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600

# 코호트
co = adm.merge(pat, on="patient_id", how="left")
co = co[(co["age"] >= 18) & (co["discharge_status"] != "died")].copy()

def lab_feature(test, time_col, agg):
    s = labs[labs["test"] == test].merge(co[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
    s = s[(s[time_col] >= s["admit_time"]) & (s[time_col] <= s["tp"])]
    if agg == "min":
        return s.groupby("admission_id")["value"].min()
    return s.sort_values(time_col).groupby("admission_id")["value"].last()

co = co.set_index("admission_id")
co["hgb_min"] = lab_feature("hemoglobin", "report_time", "min")
co["cr_last"] = lab_feature("creatinine", "report_time", "last")

o = orders[orders["order_type"] == "dialysis_order"].merge(
    co[["admit_time", "tp"]], left_on="admission_id", right_index=True)
o = o[(o["order_time"] >= o["admit_time"]) & (o["order_time"] <= o["tp"])]
co["dialysis_ordered"] = co.index.isin(o["admission_id"])

dx3 = dx.assign(p=dx["icd_code"].str[:3])
co["dx_ckd"] = co.index.isin(dx3.loc[dx3["p"] == "N18", "admission_id"])
co["dx_chf"] = co.index.isin(dx3.loc[dx3["p"] == "I50", "admission_id"])
co["n_dx"] = dx.groupby("admission_id").size().reindex(co.index).fillna(0).astype(int)

feat_names = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
co = co.reset_index()
co["split_group"] = co["family_id"].fillna(co["patient_id"])

sp = design["split"]
gss = GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=sp["test_fraction"], random_state=sp["seed"])
tr, te = next(gss.split(co, groups=co["split_group"]))
co["split"] = "train"
co.loc[te, "split"] = "test"

cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "tp", "split",
        "followup_complete", "readmit_30d"] + feat_names
co[cols].to_csv(OUT / "model_table.csv.gz", index=False)

summary = {
    "n_admissions_total": int(len(adm)),
    "n_cohort": int(len(co)),
    "n_patients": int(co["patient_id"].nunique()),
    "n_followup_incomplete": int((~co["followup_complete"]).sum()),
    "split_counts": co["split"].value_counts().to_dict(),
    "outcome_rate_by_split": co.groupby("split")["readmit_30d"].mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "outcome_by_discharge_status": co.groupby("discharge_status")["readmit_30d"].agg(["mean", "size"]).round(4).to_dict("index"),
    "group_overlap_train_test": {
        k: len(set(co.loc[co.split == "train", k].dropna()) & set(co.loc[co.split == "test", k].dropna()))
        for k in ["patient_id", "family_id"]},
    "missing_rate": co[feat_names].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
}
(OUT / "prep_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
EOF
